events.title: The recession reaches a turning point
events.description: Economic activity reaches the low point later identified by the NBER. Its official announcement follows in July 1983.

events.title: Missile-defense research sparks debate
events.description: President Reagan proposes research into defenses against nuclear missiles. Supporters and critics debate its possibilities and risks.

events.title: Challenger is lost
events.description: Seven people die when the shuttle breaks apart after launch. NASA pauses shuttle flights and investigates.

what_happened_next.text:
The recession became worse before recovery arrived. Its low point was November 1982, but that was identified later. In the middle of bad news, people could not know the recovery date or how strong it would be.

Other events changed the world around investors. President Reagan proposed research into missile defenses in 1983. In January 1986, the Challenger shuttle broke apart after launch, killing seven people. NASA stopped shuttle flights while it investigated. Important events deserve attention even when they do not provide a simple explanation for share prices.

Every investment in this set finished higher after five years. Coca-Cola led: $10,000 became about $44,900. The international share basket also beat the US basket. Cash earned interest, and bonds gained more than cash.

Those final amounts do not mean buying felt easy. A person investing at the start faced expensive borrowing and an uncertain economy. The chart shows what happened; it cannot recreate the worry of waiting without knowing the ending.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: Air travel, the oil market and the strong dollar drew attention. IBM’s new home computer showed how quickly technology was changing.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: Your starting price and the full five-year path mattered. An exciting new product was only one part of a company’s investment story.
reflection.what_faded_away: The unusual baseball season and immediate arguments about air traffic did not provide a dependable five-year investing plan.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: Nobody could know that Coca-Cola would lead these seven choices. Popularity, recent returns and a clever story were not guarantees.
